facts: TMAG provides cloaking for backpacks, large bags and umbrellas; food and drink are not allowed in galleries. Location: Visitor guidelines.
Personal photography is allowed unless otherwise indicated, but flash and tripods are not permitted. Location: Visitor guidelines.
